row_independence_argument: Bridge computes per-row library and conditional Gamma/Beta/Binomial/Poisson draws. p/alpha/effect/dispersion closure are fixed externally; no count transformation depends on other template rows. Only diagnostics aggregate across rows. Subsetting therefore preserves the joint law for selected rows, with a different RNG stream layout. Same quarter positions, parent rows and fitted response parameters. No seed search or validation-based model change.
